programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: La carrière, la vie privée, la filmographie et les secrets de vos stars hollywoodiennes préférées.

programme.title: Dixieland
programme.desc: Un jeune homme récemment sorti de prison, malchanceux et imprévisible, et une jeune fille séduisante et issue d'une famille déséquilibrée, se retrouvent entraînés dans une spirale criminelle alors qu'ils essaient de fuir leur petite ville sans avenir à la recherche d'une vie meilleure.

programme.title: Le baiser du serpent
programme.desc: En Angleterre, au XVIIe siècle, un architecte de jardin hollandais (Ewan McGregor, « Moulin Rouge ! ») est entraîné dans un réseau de passion et de trahison après avoir été engagé par un riche marchand.

programme.title: Dirty 30
programme.desc: C'est un peu l'impasse dans la vie des amies de toujours Kate (Mamrie Hart), Evie (Grace Helbig) et Charlie (Hannah Hart). A la veille de son trentième anniversaire, Kate accepte de laisser Evie et Charlie lui organiser une fête.

programme.title: Une Affaire d'amour
programme.desc: Mauvais timing : Thomas débarque à l'improviste chez son ex-copine, Sarah Pohl, une journaliste en pleine enquête sur des sans-papiers.

programme.title: Un Anglais à New York
programme.desc: Sidney Young est un intellectuel désabusé qui adore autant qu'il méprise le monde des célébrités, de la gloire et du glamour. Son magazine alternatif, Post Modern Review , se moque des stars obsédées par les médias et va à contre-courant des tendances. Lorsqu'on lui propose un poste dans le très conservateur magazine new-yorkais Sharps , c'est un véritable choc ! Il semble que Clayton Harding, le rédacteur en chef de Sharps , ait été amusé par la perturbation d'une soirée post-BAFTA par Young, accompagné d'un cochon déguisé en Babe. Commence alors la descente de Sidney vers le succès : il passe progressivement du statut d'outsider moqué à celui de confident de la starlette Sophie Maes. Au début, il est aidé chez Sharps par sa collègue Alison Olsen, qui cache elle aussi un secret. Leur amitié y survivra-t-elle ?

programme.title: Le combat d'une femme
programme.desc: Après avoir été violée, Debbie Smith n'a pas pris la loi en main. Elle a écrit la loi.

programme.title: Le carrefour du parc
programme.desc: "Il est midi dans un parc isolé au pied des collines de Los Angeles. April est venue pour se suicider Krysta et Dennis s'échangent des tendresses dans sa voiture tandis que son collègue Ian attend dans une camionnette de lavage pour chiens Peg, l'épouse de Dennis, et sa meilleure amie Claire les ont suivis et prévoient une guérilla amoureuse et quatre jeunes trentenaires du même bureau discutent dans une autre camionnette. April demande de l'aide à Ian (du lubrifiant, un tuyau, un briquet), qui lui demande s'il peut l'accompagner. Claire et Peg piègent les amants dans la voiture de Dennis puis ont une conversation intime. Nathan et Babar avouent à Meredith et Cheryl qu'ils sont nudistes, tandis que Meredith insiste pour dire que les deux hommes sont gays. Les vêtements tombent et les vérités éclatent. Est-ce juste une journée de plus à Los Angeles ?"

programme.title: Horse Camp
programme.desc: Une jeune fille se rend dans un centre équestre et apprend le véritable pouvoir de l'amitié...

programme.title: Taj mahal
programme.desc: À 18 ans, Louise loge avec sa famille dans une suite du Taj Mahal Palace. Un soir, restée seule dans sa chambre, elle entend des bruits étranges dans les couloirs de l'hôtel. Elle comprend au bout de quelques minutes qu'il s'agit d'une attaque terroriste.

programme.title: Deadly Past
programme.desc: Un barman se réconcilie avec son ex-petite amie avant de découvrir qu'il fait partie d'un stratagème criminel.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Charlie Says
programme.desc: Le film traite de charles manson, et en particulier l'influence qu'il a eu sur une jeune femme de 19 ans.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Les bas-fonds de Melbourne, dans un futur proche. Macbeth est le bras droit de Duncan, le parrain local.

programme.title: Deadly Past
programme.desc: Un barman se réconcilie avec son ex-petite amie avant de découvrir qu'il fait partie d'un stratagème criminel.

programme.title: Le prince et la romancière
programme.desc: Une auteure de romances médiévales est engagée pour trouver l'âme sœur d'un prince avant son mariage royal. Mais leur quête amoureuse pourrait bien devenir leur propre histoire d'amour.

programme.title: La Parade de Noël
programme.desc: Charlotte tente de raviver la tradition du défilé de trains de Noël pour son fils Benny. Avec l'aide du professeur de ce dernier, elle redécouvre l'esprit des fêtes… malgré des secrets du passé.

programme.title: Le ranch de mes rêves
programme.desc: Kate, jeune actrice citadine, part vivre dans un ranch pour préparer son prochain rôle. Mais en aidant Hunter à sauver son exploitation, elle découvre une vie et des sentiments inattendus.

programme.title: Un Noël tout doux
programme.desc: Jess quitte sa carrière pour participer à un concours de mode de Noël avec Andrew, père célibataire et éleveur d'alpagas. Ensemble, ils pourraient sauver la ferme… et trouver l'amour.

programme.title: Noël avec ma fille
programme.desc: Deux parents célibataires entrevoient la possibilité d'un Noël romantique, mais découvrent que leurs filles sont en proie à une rivalité féroce à l'école. Lorsque cette rivalité dégénère, l'espoir et la réconciliation pourront-ils mener chacun à un Noël paisible et joyeux ?

programme.title: Mi-Temps Au Mitard
programme.desc: Lorsque Paul Crewe, star du football américain, se retrouve en prison pour fraude sur les matchs, il ne veut plus rien avoir à faire avec ce sport. Mais les gardiens l'obligent à monter une équipe avec les autres détenus. D'un groupe de hors-la-loi disparate, Crewe doit faire une équipe capable d'affronter les gardiens décidés à en découdre.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Dans la petite ville touristique de Nelson, Washington, le sympathique chef des pompiers , C.D. Bales (Steve Martin) est sensible aux remarques sur son nez particulièrement long. Une belle astronome intelligente, Roxanne (Daryl Hannah), en ville pour étudier une comète, est attirée par un autre nouveau-venu, le pompier professionnel travaillant auprès de C.D., Chris (Rick Rossovich).

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Kate (Olivia Wilde) et Luke (Jake Johnson) travaillent ensemble dans une micro-brasserie. Leur amitié donne l'impression qu'elle pourrait mener à bien plus encore, mais voilà : Kate est avec Chris (Ron Livingston) et Luke est avec Jill (Anna Kendrick) qui veut savoir s'il est prêt à parler mariage. La réponse à cette question devient limpide quand Luke et Kate se retrouvent seuls pour un week-end ensemble. « Ivresse entre Amis» est écrit et réalisé par Joe Swanberg et met en vedette Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson, Anna Kendrick et Ron Livingston.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: En 1948, Paul Child, fonctionnaire américain, arrive à Paris avec son épouse, Julia. Cherchant une occupation dans la capitale française, celle-ci s'inscrit à des cours de cuisine et prend goût à concocter des plats pour son époux et leurs amis. de cette expérience naît un livre de recettes qui rencontre un immense succès. de nos jours, Julie Powell, employée trentenaire de New York, a l'impression de tourner en rond. Son métier l'ennuie et elle jalouse la réussite de ses amies. Pour se divertir, et sur le conseil de son mari Eric, elle décide de lancer un blog culinaire. Elle se donne 365 jours pour réaliser toutes les recettes de Julia Child...

programme.title: Témoin à Louer
programme.desc: Doug Harris a un vrai problème: le jeune homme, qui n'a pas une vie sociale très riche, est sur le point de se marier, mais n'a pas de témoin.

programme.title: Borat, nouvelle mission filmée
programme.desc: Dans cette suite hilarante, le quatrième meilleur journaliste du Kazakhstan, Borat Sagdiyev, doit offrir un "cadeau" au vice-président américain.

programme.title: The Walking Deceased
programme.desc: Un mois après l'apocalypse zombie, un groupe de survivants cherche un endroit où se réfugier.

programme.title: Les amis à vendre
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, louer des amis est devenue une habitude courante chez les nantis, leur épargnant bien des déceptions affectives. Quand Jacques et Odile tombent sur les Begond, à un prix intéressant, ils savent faire l'affaire qui les rendra plus brillants aux yeux de leurs relations…

programme.title: Scary Camp
programme.desc: Sam souffre de trous noirs et ne comprend pas pourquoi il est entouré de gens assassinés. Il se tourne alors vers une amie fan de films d'horreur pour avoir des conseils. Sam doit faire face à une terrible hypothèse : et si c'était lui, l'assassin ?

programme.title: La Fureur des Apaches
programme.desc: Un jeune officier de cavalerie est chargé d'arrêter une bande d'Apaches qui terrorisent la campagne.

programme.title: Les compagnons de la gloire
programme.desc: Un marchand d'armes suédois et un ouvrier agricole mexicain s'associent pour sauver le chef du mouvement révolutionnaire et vivent de nombreuses mésaventures.

programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Les efforts conjoints du gouvernement américain et de la nation comanche pour négocier un traité de paix sont sabotés par des Indiens renégats.

programme.title: Billy le Kid
programme.desc: Tom Carter envoie son fils Billy chercher l'aide du shérif lorsque la ferme est attaquée par les hommes de main du voisin Jon Pryce.

programme.title: Le désert rouge
programme.desc: Deux hommes trouvent un bébé abandonné et se disputent la propriété de l'enfant, ce qui entraîne une rivalité qui durera toute la vie.

programme.title: La vallée de la peur
programme.desc: Dans les années 1880, un garçon hanté par des cauchemars sur la nuit où toute sa famille a été assassinée est élevé par une famille voisine.

programme.title: La mort était au rendez-vous
programme.desc: Un jeune tireur forme une alliance ténue avec un ancien hors-la-loi vieillissant pour traquer et éliminer les bandits qui ont tué sa famille, jusqu'à la fin surprenante.

programme.title: Les femmes de Jesse James
programme.desc: Jesse James est tellement occupé à courir les jupons que sa carrière de hors-la-loi commence à en pâtir.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississipi
programme.desc: Un groupe de pirates menés par Kelly, un bandit habillé tout en noir, sème la terreur en s'en prenant aux habitants de Helena et aux bateaux postiers sur le Mississippi. Le shérif James Lively doit aller contre la méfiance des habitants mais aussi des Indiens. Mais avec l'aide des Cherokees, car les bandits se sont établis sur leurs terres, et de son adjoint Tom Quincy, il parvient à mettre fin à leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: Terreur sur l'asphalte
programme.desc: Une série de meurtres mystérieux a eu lieu à Montevideo, une petite ville en Californie. La femme d'un policier s'enfuit de son mari, cherchant à divorcer. Le policier tente de se réconcilier et commence à la suivre...

programme.title: Heartless
programme.desc: Jamie Morgan, un jeune homme portant une grande tache de naissance en forme de cœur sur le visage, découvre qu'il y a des démons dans les rues de l'est de Londres.

programme.title: Yeti
programme.desc: Un avion s'écrase dans les montagnes de l'Himalaya. Pris au piège au milieu des falaises abruptes, les rescapés s'organisent pour leur survie. Ils sont attaqués par une créature affamée et assoiffée de sang: un abominable homme des neiges qui aime la chair humaine.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Un virus a décimé l'humanité. Les rescapés tentent de survivre mais ces petits hameaux sont terrorisés par Apocalypta qui contrôle une armée de zombies appelée Copperheads. Une bande hétéroclite de cowboys vont alors unir leurs forces pour les affronter.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Des astronautes en mission pour sauver l'humanité se réveillent et découvrent que leur vaisseau a été envahi par des créatures mortelles.

programme.title: Le Retour des morts-vivants 3
programme.desc: Un jeune homme utilise un produit chimique et un programme gouvernemental secret pour réanimer sa petite amie décédée, et lui aide à consommer la seule chose qui la nourrira: des cerveaux humains.

programme.title: Les dieux des profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une mission audacieuse conduit une équipe de sous-marin en eaux profondes dans une mystérieuse ouverture au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent son ancienne race d'êtres d'un autre monde...

programme.title: T.I.M.
programme.desc: Abi, jeune ingénieure, s'installe à la campagne avec son mari pour travailler sur le dernier produit de sa société, une intelligence artificelle humanoïde appelée TIM. Programmé pour ne servir qu'elle, TIM développe peu à peu une obsession pour Abi, et semble déterminé à remplacer Paul, son mari.

programme.title: The Rage
programme.desc: Une épidémie de rage se déclare dans la taïga russe.

programme.title: Escape the Field
programme.desc: Six inconnus piégés dans un champ de maïs doivent s'unir pour échapper à une mystérieuse menace.

programme.title: Guerrier
programme.desc: Un guerrier blessé découvre une petite tribu cachée et, face à la guerre imminente, ils partent à sa rencontre.

programme.title: Le Sorcier et le Serpent Blanc
programme.desc: Un maître moine tente de protéger un jeune médecin naïf d'un démon serpent vieux de mille ans. Un affrontement de pouvoirs psychiques s'ensuit, plongeant tout dans le chaos.

programme.title: Closer To God
programme.desc: Le généticien Victor Reed crée un clone humain, suscitant une vive controverse.

programme.title: Vamps
programme.desc: Au XVIII? siècle, un noble russe affronte des créatures maléfiques dans une région hantée.

programme.title: Dagon
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un voilier s'échoue sur la côte espagnole, deux naufragés cherchent refuge à Imboca, un village isolé. Mais derrière son apparente ruine, la ville cache une secte vouée à Dagon, une divinité marine avide de sacrifices.

programme.title: War Of Apes
programme.desc: Pour sauver l'humanité, un gigantesque singe et son ennemi mécanique, Mecha Ape MkII, s'allient.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: Un groupe d'étudiants se rend dans la forêt tropicale à la recherche de dessins rupestres. Mais un boa constricteur de quinze mètres que l'on croyait éteint a faim de sang.

programme.title: Robert the Bruce
programme.desc: Ecosse 1306. Robert Bruce lutte pour l'indépendance mais est pourchassé par les sbires d'Edouard 1er.

programme.title: Measure Of Revenge
programme.desc: Le fils de Lillian meurt mystérieusement. L'enquête conclut à une overdose mais Lilian n'y croit pas.

programme.title: Roses à crédit
programme.desc: Après-guerre, Marjolaine est accro aux biens matériels, son mari préfère une vie traditionnelle.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Un jeune homme lutte pour retrouver son amour perdu lors de la construction du mur de Berlin.

programme.title: Bad Match
programme.desc: Harris enchaîne les conquêtes d'un soir grâce aux applis de rencontre. Tout marche comme sur des roulettes jusqu'au moment où il rencontre la belle et séduisante Riley…

programme.title: Hyena Road
programme.desc: Trois hommes différents, trois mondes différents, trois guerres différentes - tous se trouvent à l'intersection de la guerre moderne - un monde trouble à la moralité fluctuante où tout n'est pas ce qu'il semble être.

programme.title: Deux semaines
programme.desc: Sally Field livre une performance puissante dans cette comédie dramatique sur la détermination d'une famille à rester ensemble jusqu'à la fin quand quatre adultes rentrent chez eux pour ce qu'ils pensent être les derniers jours de leur mère malade.

programme.title: Infidèle
programme.desc: Connie, une épouse et mère d'âge mûr, a une liaison avec Paul, un beau jeune Français. Lorsque le mari de Connie, Edward, commence à les soupçonner, il engage un détective privé. Quand ses craintes sont confirmées, Edward affronte Paul et prend une décision qui viendra le hanter.

programme.title: The wee man
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de Paul Ferris.

programme.title: Shark Terror
programme.desc: Naufragée après une croisière, une jeune femme blessée est traquée par des requins

programme.title: The Thompsons
programme.desc: Une famille de vampires se rend en Angleterre à la recherche d'un ancien clan de vampires

programme.title: Dans les griffes de mon sauveur
programme.desc: Laura est sauvée par un homme mystérieux... Une histoire qui remet en question les apparences.

programme.title: The river king
programme.desc: Un jeune inspecteur de police d'une petite ville doit enquêter sur la noyade d'un étudiant.

programme.title: Pris pour cible
programme.desc: Quand des mercenaires impitoyables prennen le contrôle d'un hôtel de villégiature, d'anciens soldats des opérations spéciales qui assistent au mariage de leur meilleur ami doivent compter sur leur entraînement pour combattre les terroristes et sauver les otages.

programme.title: La guerre des mafias
programme.desc: Terry est libéré plus tôt que prévu de prisonn. Il doit infiltrer la Cosa Nostra en Italie pour démanteler le réseau. Le premier jour, les six membres de son unité sont éliminés. Terry va passer toute une journée avec un tueur psychopathe qui sait peut-être qu'il travaille pour la police.

programme.title: Rogue

Sa vie bascule encore davantage lorsqu'elle découvre qu'un monstre vit désormais chez elle.

programme.title: Frayeurs

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: Fou de rage après l'agression de son épouse et le meurtre de son fils et écœuré par le laxisme et la corruption des autorités, qui ont permis aux responsables d'être libérés, un électricien new-yorkais s'acoquine avec un groupe d'auto-défense, dans lequel il refusait d'entrer jusqu'alors, afin de venger sa famille.

programme.title: L'Enfer des Zombies
programme.desc: Un navire venu des Antilles accoste au port de New York sans âme qui vive à bord, si ce n'est un zombie qui attaque deux gardes côtes. Avec l'aide d'un journaliste, la fille du propriétaire du bateau décide d'aller enquêter aux Antilles pour retrouver son père. Ils se rendent sur l'île de Matu et y rencontrent le docteur David Menard, qui tente d'inventer un remède contre une maladie qui ramène les morts à la vie, les changeant en zombies cannibales.

programme.title: Demon City Shinjuku

Avec l'aide de Sayaka, la fille du président du monde libre, et d'étranges alliés rencontrés en chemin, il doit traverser les ruines infestées de créatures démoniaques pour empêcher Rebi Ra d'ouvrir un portail vers les enfers et de plonger le monde entier dans le chaos.

programme.title: David Tennant On The Struggles Throughout His Acting Career
programme.desc: David Tennant discusses the anxieties and stage fright he experiences as an actor, even with critical acclaim, and how a little fear can be useful to prevent complacency. He and Fearne explore how to work through moments when anxiety threatens to overwhelm you, and how concrete experiences over time provide a coping mechanism. David also shares his thoughts on whether celebrities should use their platform for social activism, and verifies some stories from online about his life.

programme.title: Dave Grohl On Overcoming Fear And Pursuing Your Dream
programme.desc: Foo Fighters and Nirvana drummer Dave Grohl discusses his new memoir The Storyteller, written during the pandemic. He talks with Fearne Cotton about the law of attraction, pursuing your dreams, and the importance of embracing mistakes and the unknown. Grohl reflects on his journey from hitting the road with Scream at 18 to his time in Nirvana and Foo Fighters, and how storytelling shaped his life from childhood in Springfield, Virginia.

programme.title: Chris McCausland: My Body Rests But My Brain Doesn't!
programme.desc: Comedian Chris McCausland chats with Fearne Cotton about holidays and travel. Chris explains how losing his sight has changed the way he approaches holidays, from planning activities and communicating in foreign countries to managing his dependence on loved ones. He discusses getting into his daughter's favourite holiday hobby: rollercoasters.

programme.title: Ant & Dec On Anxiety, Gratitude & Turning 50
programme.desc: In their first ever podcast appearance, Ant and Dec join Fearne and explain that nearly four decades into their careers they're still laughing together just as much as they did at the beginning, but now they've got far more gratitude for each day they get to be on TV.

programme.title: Caitlin Moran On How She Finally Calmed Her Nervous System
programme.desc: Writer Caitlin Moran discusses her 30-year battle with anxiety that began at age 13, and how she's now two years anxiety-free through choosing to be hopeful and see the good in life. She talks with Fearne Cotton about how social media has altered our perception of reality, the difference between posting angrily online and taking real-world action, social anxiety when meeting friends, and how presuming everyone's having a bad day can make you happier.

programme.title: Ashley Roberts On Coping With Anxiety And Insomnia
programme.desc: Ashley Roberts discusses her journey through burnout and body shaming during the height of the Pussycat Dolls' fame, and how discovering breathwork helped her recover from intense anxiety and physical ill-health. She talks about her mental health toolkit, the grief of losing her dad to suicide, and family mental illness. With Fearne Cotton, she shares experiences of insomnia and coping strategies.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump's Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Little Elliot gets his big sister Emma to enter the Grand Sand Sculpture contest with him. Meanwhile Cleo's day starts badly at the Oceanic Center: Mr. Lambert puts her in charge of the new intern - Miriam, the Mayor's daughter and high school pest! Miriam lives up to her reputation, and submits Cleo to a series of capricious outbursts.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: During a scientific experiment conducted by Lewis out at sea, the three mermaids find a wooden statue of a white mermaid on the seafloor! Lewis discovers it's the figurehead of a famous pirate galleon, the White Mermaid, which sank at sea without a trace! Rikki and Emma are thrilled, while Cleo is preoccupied by something else.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Emma's in a dilemma: handsome Byron has invited her to his birthday party on his uncle's yacht. Her girlfriends tell her it's no place for someone who transforms into a mermaid at the slightest drop of water. But Emma willfully goes along. Afraid she'll do something silly, her girlfriends and Lewis join the party.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: A grand holiday resort on Mako Island? Its idyllic slopes covered with concrete and the volcanic lake inside the mountain, where the mermaids first transformed, converted into a swimming pool? Only Zane's father could have dreamed up such a development. But Emma, Cleo and Rikki aren't going to let this happen!

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Emma loses her mermaid nature and her powers after touching some mysterious blue seaweed. Remembering what it's like being “normal” - she used to be a passionate swimmer - she rejoins the synchronized swimming team, which is preparing a show for the Summer Solstice Festival.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: More and more plastic bags are polluting Dolphin City Bay, and the turtles mistake the bags for sea-sponges and suffocate on them. Our three mermaids, alerted by their friend Teddy the turtle, tackle the problem. After some unsuccessful attempts, they and Lewis decide to use stronger methods to stir up public opinion.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a violent storm, Dolphin City looks like a new Bermuda Triangle: boats mysteriously break down or sink in the bay. At the sight of hordes of journalists, the girls investigate, with Lewis' help. They find out that a lightning bolt from the storm has activated mysterious crystals whose magnetic field disrupts navigation equipment.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: When Emma, Cleo and Rikki find out two superstars – Brad Patinson and Scarlett Belladonna - are shooting a film in Dolphin City, directed by the famous Martin Fabiola, they try anything to get on the set. Luckily Zane has been hired by the production! Only Rikki prefers to approach the stars in her own way – underwater of course!

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Murray and Burke are inconsolable: their pal Danny the octopus has disappeared! By chance, Cleo finds out that he's in fact been captured by the Oceanic Center, who are conducting scientific research. Murray puts pressure on the mermaids to get Danny out of there and bring him back to the sea. But Danny doesn't want to go home.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Why has a whale calf run aground on an isolated beach near Dolphin City? And what's causing the girls' migraines? Does it have anything to do with the dolphin twins' bizarre sickness? During their investigations the mermaids come across a strange fishing boat using illegal technology: an extremely low-frequency military radar device.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Burke the hammerhead shark has broken a tooth. To sooth the pain, he has to come up for air at the surface regularly: but in so doing, he involuntarily shows his fin. Before long a panic wave runs through the citizens of Dolphin City, who think they've got a dangerous shark on their hands.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Rikki has to make up for her mistakes! Convinced that her father's new girlfriend, Cathy, is dishonest, Rikki sabotages the dinner in which her father tried to ask Cathy for her hand in marriage. To bring the estranged sweethearts back together, Rikki absolutely has to recover the lost engagement ring, which fell into the sea during that tumultuous dinner.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Worrying events agitate the little underwater community of the Bay: clownfish are inexplicably disappearing one after another. The mermaids try to get to the bottom of this mystery, to find their friend Ziggy, a little clownfish who's among those missing.

programme.title: Doctor Prisoner Ep.16 (English Dub)

programme.desc: "The first kiss on that day" Munho is still miserable because of the memories of that day, which he cannot erase. Once she finds out that a big shot is behind Yunhui, Yeongsin struggles with whether or not to write the story. Jeonghu monitors Yeongsin in order to catch the person who framed him, and notices another person watching Yeongsin: Munho.

programme.title: Healer Ep.4 (English Dub)
programme.desc: "Because I'm by your side" Jeonghu continues to work undercover in order to use Yeongsin as bait. Yeongsin publishes an article that disturbs high-ranking officials, and Munho senses the danger that will befall her. Jeonghu faces a situation in which he must choose between his safety and Yeongsin's safety...

The decision seems to be inevitable if he wants to keep his promise to become a king who always considers the best for the nation and the people.

programme.desc: Premier Kim's servant discovers that Hong Gyeongnae's daughter is called Hong Raon and she is currently in the palace. Knowing Eunuch Hong is Raon, Yunseong secretly gets rid of him and warns the Crown Prince that she needs to leave the palace as soon as possible. However, Yeong is determined to go through any hardships to be with her.

programme.title: Love in the Moonlight Ep.13
programme.desc: Raon finds out that she is Hong Gyeongnae's daughter and realizes she can never be safe in the palace. Without telling Yeong the truth, she spends the day with him and leaves quietly. Meanwhile, the officials start searching out the Baekwoon Group's spies, especially Hong Gyeongnae's daughter who is said to be residing in the palace.

programme.title: Love in the Moonlight Ep.14
programme.desc: The Crown Prince finds out that Eunuch Hong is actually Hong Gyeongnae's daughter, but he cannot believe she approached him on purpose as a spy. He feels so lost and betrayed that he doesn't know what to do. Meanwhile, Raon is also in pain because of the fact that she has to stay far away from him for everyone's sake.

programme.title: Love in the Moonlight Ep.15
programme.desc: Yeong is heartbroken that he has become the person who only makes life difficult for Raon. He asks Byeongyeon to let him see Raon once more, and Raon meets him just to say goodbye. She pretends as if she became a eunuch on purpose as a rebel so that Yeong would forget about her and not feel apologetic for marrying someone else.

programme.title: Love in the Moonlight Ep.16
programme.desc: The palace guards capture Hong Gyeongnae alive and prepare for the interrogation. Meanwhile, Yeong visits Hong Gyeongnae in prison and they discuss the world they dream of.

programme.title: Meet The Marsupials

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Idlewild - Avalon - Belle of Louisville - these three names stand for the last still roadworthy, historic sternwheeler in the USA. In 1914, the ship was built as "Idlewild" for the West Memphis Packet Company as a passenger ferry. With a draft of only 1.50 m and a robust steel hull, the boat is suitable for almost all navigable rivers of the Mississippi River system. Today, the "Belle" is the most traveled steamboat in American history. In the course of her eventful life, she has called at 130 places in 19 states.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: The paddle steamer "Skibladner" is the oldest passenger paddle steamer in the world in regular service. It has been plying Norway's largest inland lake, the Mjøsa, since 1856. The "white swan" has a melodious name, borrowed from Norse mythology. The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Rivers and Lakes
programme.desc: Water is the beginning of all life - including the wildlife of Germany. Beavers fell trees, otters play under water, kingfishers catch fish for their young. Lakes and rivers cover just 2.5% of the total area of the country. The episode Rivers and Lakes takes the viewer on a journey through the water world of Germany. In winter, the few ice-free surfaces are popular with waterfowl. Coots throng the source ponds of the River Havel, while above them white-tailed eagles gather for the hunt, as their prey swim openly beneath them. The coots stick together, swimming to and fro to make it difficult for the eagles to pick out one individual bird. But with each attack, the coots grow increasingly tired. In Spring, the ice melts and the lakes and rivers awake from their winter torpor. Germany has more than 800 rivers longer than 10km. They transport the life-giving liquid into all corners of the country. The water of the River Danube alone would be enough to fill Germany's biggest body of water, Lake Constance, in 12 months. Every year, six times the volume of the lake falls in the form of precipitation: 800 litres per square metre. Otters and beavers had a very hard time in recent centuries. They were hunted mercilessly for their fur and eaten in periods of fasting. Today, both species are protected and their populations are recovering.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: Stephanie's Surprise Party
programme.desc: When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they soon discover that it's not easy keeping their plans secret from Stephanie who becomes suspicious when none of the girls have time to hang out. When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they discover that it's not easy keeping their plans a secret. As the girls choreograph a dance routine, magic show and search for the perfect present and cake, Stephanie becomes aware that her friends are avoiding her on her birthday and excluding her from their activities... Little does she know that her friends are secretly preparing a surprise pool party for her! Once the surprise is revealed Stephanie realises how much her friends care about her and the importance of friendship.

programme.title: Dolphin Cruise
programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. When Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a school science contest and win a Dolphin sight-seeing trip, not everything goes to plan...As the girls set out to sea on a luxury yacht, misunderstandings and disagreements occur which become secondary when they discover a pod of dolphins in danger. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

programme.title: Rise Of The Snakes
programme.desc: The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off. The Ninja dismiss him as a threat, but regret that choice after Lloyd wakes up the evil snake tribe. A prophecy is revealed that states a green ninja will ultimately defeat Lord Garmadon.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him and return to find that the snakes have burned it to the ground.

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. Can the NEXO-Knights bring order out of the chaos and save the King? Jestro finds the Book of Chaos in the countryside and decides he must feed it to the book. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it's not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn't like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him. Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Grim Testament About One Snotty Boy
programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories

programme.desc: Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?! Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn't like history lessons. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Sudden Death

Health officials think a new strain of the bacteria may be invading the population. The Provincial Laboratory discovers that a new genetic strain has indeed been introduced, but luckily, the meningitis vaccine that exists will still work against it. The Public Health Authority must act quickly to vaccinate and immunize over 50,000 young people before the bacteria claims any more victims.

programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE

programme.desc: A new personality appears in Do Hyun — this time, that of a young child — leaving him shocked. Meanwhile, Se Gi drags Ri Jin off to somewhere unknown.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.5
programme.desc: Se Gi, who has kidnapped Ri Jin, asks her to make Do Hyun disappear forever. Director Ahn begins tracking their whereabouts. Meanwhile, Do Hyun ends up at Ri On's house, and Ri On introduces him to his family as “Mr. Perry.”

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.6
programme.desc: Do Hyun can't stop thinking about Ri Jin, which only fuels Se Gi's jealousy. Eventually, Se Gi warns him, “If you touch my woman, yours will be in danger.” Provoked, Do Hyun goes to Ri Jin and asks her to become his secret personal doctor.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.7
programme.desc: Tae Im questions Director Ahn about the reason for Do Hyun's return to Korea, leaving him flustered. Ri Jin struggles to stop Yo Seob from taking his own life. Hwa Ran orders someone to find Min Seo Yeon's long-lost child, while Do Hyun begins strategizing to meet the mysterious writer Omega.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.8
programme.desc: Gi Joon proposes to Chae Yeon, but she gets angry at his attitude. Ri Jin agrees to be Do Hyun's secret doctor, but is shocked to learn she has to live in the same house as him. Thus begins their uneasy and awkward cohabitation.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.9
programme.desc: Ri Jin encounters all of Do Hyun's personalities in one night — except for Shin Se Gi. Gi Joon and Chae Yeon are stunned when Ri Jin shows up at the company as Do Hyun's secretary, while Ri On meets Do Hyun under his secret identity as Writer Omega.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.10
programme.desc: Se Gi declares all-out war against Do Hyun, and Ri Jin is taken aback by his icy demeanor. Chae Yeon is startled when Se Gi suddenly appears before her. When Se Gi arrives at the company, all eyes turn to him, and he even confronts Gi Joon directly. Meanwhile, Hwa Ran meets Ri Jin and tells her to report everything Do Hyun does.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Wellbeing behind the wheel – The new Bentley Azure Range
programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Pure Design
programme.desc: Nadine and Jacques are a young, unmarried couple (they also have a wiener dog named Sasha). They like to entertain and find there isn't enough seating for all of their guests.

programme.title: Pure Design

They now want a grown up living room that reflects who they are and helps them feel like they are in an adult space.

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: Cinque amici trascorrono un weekend in una baita sul lago proprio mentre una massiccia invasione aliena colpisce la Terra. Dopo misteriosi rapimenti, i superstiti sono costretti ad affidarsi a un eccentrico cacciatore che sostiene di aver atteso per anni l'arrivo di quel giorno.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: Quinn, membro di un'unità SWAT, riemerge da una fontana in Vietnam senza memoria del proprio passato. Mentre cerca di ricostruire ciò che gli è accaduto e di ritrovare la figlia scomparsa, viene braccato da figure misteriose e scopre una minaccia che sembra provenire da un altro mondo.

programme.title: Tides
programme.desc: In un futuro in cui la Terra è stata devastata e quasi sommersa, un'astronauta torna sul pianeta per scoprire se può essere nuovamente abitato. Rimasta sola tra comunità di sopravvissuti e lotte per il controllo delle risorse, dovrà prendere una decisione da cui dipende il futuro dell'umanità.

programme.title: Independents' Day
programme.desc: Una potente razza aliena invade la Terra e offre all'umanità un ultimatum. Mentre città e governi crollano, il Presidente degli Stati Uniti deve decidere se fidarsi delle promesse degli invasori o guidare la resistenza. Il futuro del pianeta dipende da una scelta che non ammette errori.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Un'immersione tra le rovine di una città sommersa si trasforma in un incubo. Quattro amiche sono intrappolate sott'acqua, circondate da squali letali e cunicoli che sembrano stringersi attorno a loro. Sopravvivere richiede sangue freddo… e pura fortuna.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente aereo, cinque amici si ritrovano su una zattera in mezzo al mare, senza cibo né aiuto in vista. Gli squali affamati pattugliano ogni loro mossa, trasformando il mare in una trappola mortale. Sopravvivere sembra impossibile, ma arrendersi non è un'opzione.

programme.title: The Eye
